title: Bear cub eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bear cub sitting, eating a snack -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#a86a3c'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8a542e'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='90' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8a542e'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='90' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <!-- arms holding food -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='68' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#a86a3c' transform='rotate(20 32 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='68' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#a86a3c' transform='rotate(-20 68 68)'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='8' fill='#a86a3c'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='8' fill='#a86a3c'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='4' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='4' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#a86a3c'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#e8b878'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='34' r='3' fill='#3a2416'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='3' fill='#3a2416'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='33' r='1' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='1' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2416'/>
  <!-- snack: honey cookie -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='9' fill='#e8a13a'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='59' r='2' fill='#8a542e'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='60' r='2' fill='#8a542e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='2' fill='#8a542e'/>
  <!-- mouth open toward snack -->
  <path d='M46 50 Q50 54 54 50' stroke='#3a2416' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
